name: SacCubing XXIV 2026
information: ## On-site registration will be available for a fee of $35. Megaminx will not be eligible as an event to register for via on-site registration. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b461cbfe0cad33e2120f14293fe68e84c3bb5009/sac_transparent%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0MTU3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--659aed49175c550db55c7bfc1c07bdd91b7157ac/Gancube.png) #### SacCubing returns with our 24th iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot! * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses. **This competition is proudly sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](https://Speedcubeshop.com) and [GANCube](https://www.gancube.com/)!**
